title: Alphabet Completes $32B Acquisition of Wiz Cloud Security
summary: Alphabet Inc. completed its landmark $32 billion acquisition of Israeli cloud security firm Wiz, marking the largest acquisition in Alphabet's history. The deal consolidates Google Cloud's security posture against AWS and Azure.

title: BlackRock Closes $12.5B Acquisition of HPS Investment Partners
summary: BlackRock Inc. closed its $12.5 billion acquisition of HPS Investment Partners, significantly expanding its private credit platform to over $220 billion in alternative assets.

title: Capital One Finalises $35.3B Acquisition of Discover Financial
summary: Capital One Financial Corporation completed its $35.3 billion acquisition of Discover Financial Services following regulatory approval, creating the largest US credit card company by loan volume.

title: Mars Inc. Signs $36B Deal to Acquire Kellanova
summary: Mars Incorporated agreed to acquire snacks maker Kellanova in a $36 billion deal, creating one of the world's largest snack food companies. The deal includes Pringles, Cheez-It, and Pop-Tarts brands.

title: Synopsys Completes $35B Acquisition of Ansys After Regulatory Clearance
summary: Synopsys completed its $35 billion acquisition of simulation software maker Ansys after receiving approval from US, EU, and Chinese regulators. Combined entity targets $7B revenue by 2027.

title: Apollo Global Management Acquires Intel Fab Assets for $11B
summary: Apollo Global Management agreed to acquire a 49% stake in Intel's Ireland and Germany fab assets in an $11 billion deal, helping Intel de-risk its foundry expansion plans.

title: Nippon Steel Revises US Steel Bid to $15.3B Amid Political Pressure
summary: Nippon Steel raised its bid for US Steel to $15.3 billion and offered additional investment commitments after the original deal faced national security scrutiny. CFIUS review ongoing.

title: ExxonMobil Completes $60B Pioneer Natural Resources Acquisition
summary: ExxonMobil finalised its $60 billion acquisition of Pioneer Natural Resources, its largest deal ever, doubling its Permian Basin production capacity to over 1.3 million barrels per day.

title: Chevron Acquires Hess Corporation for $53B After Arbitration Resolution
summary: Chevron completed its $53 billion acquisition of Hess Corporation following resolution of an arbitration dispute over Hess's Guyana oil stake. The deal gives Chevron access to 30% of the Stabroek block.

title: Pfizer Acquires Seagen Oncology for $43B to Bolster Cancer Portfolio
summary: Pfizer completed its $43 billion acquisition of oncology specialist Seagen, gaining a portfolio of four approved antibody-drug conjugates and a deep clinical pipeline targeting solid tumours.

title: Cisco Systems Closes $28B Splunk Acquisition
summary: Cisco Systems completed its $28 billion acquisition of Splunk, integrating the cybersecurity and data analytics platform into Cisco's networking and security business unit.

title: AstraZeneca Acquires Fusion Pharmaceuticals for $2.4B in Radiopharmaceutical Push
summary: AstraZeneca agreed to acquire Fusion Pharmaceuticals for $2.4 billion including milestones, gaining access to targeted radioligand therapies for cancer treatment.

title: Mastercard to Acquire Recorded Future Threat Intelligence for $2.65B
summary: Mastercard agreed to acquire Recorded Future, the world's largest threat intelligence company, for $2.65 billion to strengthen its cybersecurity offerings for financial institutions.

title: HSBC Completes Sale of Canadian Banking Unit to Royal Bank for $10B
summary: HSBC completed the sale of its Canadian retail banking operations to Royal Bank of Canada for CAD $13.5 billion (~$10 billion USD), transferring approximately 780,000 customers.

title: UnitedHealth Group Acquires Amedisys Home Health for $3.3B
summary: UnitedHealth Group's Optum division completed its $3.3 billion acquisition of home health and hospice provider Amedisys, expanding its care-at-home services footprint to 40 states.

title: Brookfield Asset Management Acquires Network International for $2.8B
summary: Brookfield Asset Management completed its £2.2 billion (~$2.8B) acquisition of Network International, the leading payments processor in the Middle East and Africa, taking the company private.

title: Abu Dhabi's ADNOC Acquires Covestro Specialty Chemicals for $16.4B
summary: ADNOC completed its €14.7 billion ($16.4B) acquisition of Covestro, the German specialty chemicals maker, marking one of the largest European M&A transactions of the decade.

title: Novo Holdings Acquires Catalent CDMO for $16.5B
summary: Novo Holdings, parent of Novo Nordisk, completed its $16.5 billion acquisition of contract drug manufacturer Catalent, securing manufacturing capacity for GLP-1 diabetes and obesity drugs.

title: Silver Lake Takes Endeavor Group Private in $13B Deal
summary: Silver Lake Partners completed its $13 billion take-private of Endeavor Group Holdings, the entertainment and sports conglomerate that owns UFC, IMG, and the Miss Universe Organisation.

title: Johnson & Johnson Acquires Shockwave Medical for $13.1B
summary: Johnson & Johnson completed its $13.1 billion acquisition of Shockwave Medical, gaining the market-leading intravascular lithotripsy technology for treating calcified cardiovascular disease.

title: Henkel Divests Consumer Adhesives to Lone Star Funds for $4.6B
summary: Henkel agreed to sell its consumer adhesives business, including the Loctite and Pritt brands, to Lone Star Funds for €4.2 billion ($4.6B), focusing on industrial adhesives.

title: T-Mobile Acquires US Cellular for $4.4B in Spectrum Deal
summary: T-Mobile US completed its $4.4 billion acquisition of US Cellular assets, gaining spectrum licenses and 4.5 million wireless customers, strengthening coverage in rural Midwest markets.

title: Vista Equity Acquires Jaggaer Procurement Software for $2.1B
summary: Vista Equity Partners agreed to acquire Jaggaer, a provider of procurement and supply chain software, for $2.1 billion, continuing its strategy of consolidating enterprise SaaS platforms.

title: BHP Acquires Anglo American's Copper Assets for $9.8B
summary: BHP Group completed its $9.8 billion acquisition of Anglo American's copper mining assets in Chile and Peru, making BHP the world's largest copper producer ahead of the clean energy transition.

title: Amgen Complires $27.8B Acquisition of Horizon Therapeutics
summary: Amgen completed its $27.8 billion acquisition of Horizon Therapeutics following FTC settlement, gaining the rare disease blockbuster TEPEZZA for thyroid eye disease.

title: Brookfield to Acquire Grifols Blood Plasma Business for $10.2B
summary: Brookfield Asset Management agreed to acquire a majority stake in Grifols' blood plasma and biologics business in a deal valuing the unit at $10.2 billion, taking the Spanish biotech private.

title: CVC Capital Partners Acquires Adevinta Classifieds for $8.8B
summary: CVC Capital Partners, Blackstone, and Permira completed the €8 billion ($8.8B) take-private of Adevinta, the world's largest online classifieds company operating 25 platforms across 16 countries.

title: SoftBank to Acquire Ampere Computing from Renesas for $6.5B
summary: SoftBank Group agreed to acquire Ampere Computing, the Arm-based server chip maker, from Renesas Electronics in a $6.5 billion deal, strengthening SoftBank's AI computing infrastructure play.

title: Qualcomm Acquires Movian AI Automotive Software Startup for $2.3B
summary: Qualcomm agreed to acquire Movian, a Swedish startup specializing in AI-driven vehicle software stacks, for $2.3 billion to accelerate its automotive ADAS and cockpit platform ambitions.

title: LVMH in Talks to Acquire Moncler Luxury Apparel for $15B
summary: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton is reportedly in advanced discussions to acquire Italian luxury outerwear brand Moncler in a deal that could value the company at €13.5 billion ($15B).
